post.summary:
Sends an admin-authored email to the guest on a booking. Failures are 400s split by cause:
a server with no SMTP settings answers `email.not_configured`, a send that reached the
transport and failed answers `booking.email_send_failed`. A caller cannot retry its way
out of the first.

get.summary:
Key metadata only (id/name/prefix/scopes) plus the acting user's email/role — never the
hash or secret. A JWT/browser session gets 400 rather than a lookup: it authenticated
without a key, so there is nothing to introspect.

GET /api/admin/audit?actorUserId=1&action=booking&targetType=Booking&restaurantId=2&from=…&to=…&page=1&pageSize=25
`action` matches by prefix. Same envelope as the notification history.

post.summary:
The endpoint takes no token by design — clearing a cookie that was never set has to
succeed — so an anonymous POST would land an actor-less row, and could be repeated to bury
the entries that matter. Only a real session is recorded.
<seealso>AuditTrailTests.Logout_IsRecordedForASessionAndIgnoredWithoutOne</seealso>

get.summary:
The security question for a given account, for the forgot-password screen (which has no
session yet). This confirms whether an address has an account with a question configured
— an accepted trade-off for a self-hosted, internal tool, bounded by the `auth`
rate-limit policy. The signed-in equivalent is `GET pvq/me`.
Returns the user's recent bookings from their encrypted HttpOnly cookie.

The iOS app icon a self-hoster's native build bakes in. Deliberately not a
`pwa-icon-1024.png`: the PWA shape carries the transparency App Store Connect rejects.
The foreground layer of the Android adaptive icon; the background layer is the brand colour from `GET api/brand`.

Whether outgoing mail can be sent at all, and whether booking confirmations are switched
on — two different causes with the same visible effect (guests receive nothing), which a
script has to be able to tell apart. Carries no host, username or password, masked or
otherwise.

Recent delivery failures. The recipient is a customer's email address, so it goes through
the same BookingGuestVisibility gate a booking read does — otherwise a key
holding `email:read` but not `guests:read` would read guest identities out of
the failure list that the booking endpoints redact.

post.summary:
Places a temporary hold on a table for a given date.
Returns 409 Conflict if the table is already held by someone else.
When int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableId/int? PlaceHoldRequest.SectionId
are omitted, the server auto-assigns the best available table across all sections.
When int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableGroupId is set, the server reserves all member
tables of that combinable group as one hold (#272).

delete.summary:
Releases a hold early (e.g., when the user navigates away).
Safe to call even if the hold has already expired.

get.summary:
The readiness checklist, the configured minimum app version, and aggregate use per native
build. Read-only: nothing here mutates the deployment.
<seealso>NativeAppControllerTests.Status_WithoutAuth_Returns401</seealso>
<seealso>NativeAppControllerTests.Status_WithAdminJwt_ReturnsTheFiveChecks</seealso>
<seealso>NativeAppControllerTests.Status_WithABookingsOnlyKey_Returns403</seealso>
<seealso>NativeAppControllerTests.Status_WithABrandReadKey_Returns200</seealso>

List notification history with optional filters, newest first.
GET /api/admin/notifications?restaurantId=1&type=BookingCreated&unreadOnly=true&page=1&pageSize=20
restaurantId is optional — omit to see all restaurants.
type values: BookingCreated | BookingCancelled | RestaurantNearlyFull

Unread count badge. Omit restaurantId to get total across all restaurants.
GET /api/admin/notifications/unread-count
GET /api/admin/notifications/unread-count?restaurantId=1

patch.summary:
Mark a single notification as read.
PATCH /api/admin/notifications/{id}/read

Mark all notifications for a restaurant as read.
PATCH /api/admin/notifications/read-all?restaurantId=1

get.summary:
Returns the VAPID public key for the frontend to use when subscribing.
GET /api/admin/push/vapid-public-key
Returns 204 if VAPID is not configured (push disabled).

delete.summary:
Remove a push subscription (logout / permission revoked).
DELETE /api/admin/push/subscribe
Body: "https://fcm.googleapis.com/..."

ApiKeyScopeDto.description:
One `{resource, access}` pair — see ApiKeyScopes
for the allow-list. Doubles as the shape persisted in `AdminApiKey.ScopesJson`, so the
codec lives here rather than in the service: the read side (the authentication handler) and
the write side (the management service) both need it and neither owns the other.

tableGroupId.description:
When set, this booking reserves a combinable-table group (#272) instead of a single table.
IReadOnlyList<int>? BookingDto.MemberTableIds carries the group's member ids for the conflict check; both are
resolved server-side. Only int? BookingDto.TableGroupId is persisted on the booking entity.

memberTableIds.description:
Member table ids the server resolved for int? BookingDto.TableGroupId while auto-assigning.
Never read back from a client request — the booking path always re-resolves the members from
the persisted group, so a caller can't shrink this list to dodge a conflict check.

seats.description: Party size. Bounded to [int BookingLimits.MinSeats, int BookingLimits.MaxSeats] on create.

holdId.description:
Optional hold ID obtained from POST /api/holds.
Provide this when creating a booking to validate and consume the hold.
Not returned in responses.

phoneNumber.description: Default contact phone. Empty string clears it; null leaves the stored value unchanged.

emailAddress.description: Default contact email. Empty string clears it; null leaves the stored value unchanged.

headerImageFit.description: "Cover" (default) or "Contain". Null means leave the stored value unchanged.

privacyPolicyUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. Empty string clears it; null leaves the stored value unchanged.

minimumAppVersion.description: Strict `major.minor.patch`. Empty string clears it; null leaves the stored value unchanged.

expiresAt.description:
An explicit expiry. Omit this to get the safe default (see
    bool CreateApiKeyRequest.NeverExpires); when set, it must be in the future and
    bool CreateApiKeyRequest.NeverExpires must not also be true.

neverExpires.description:
Opts a key out of the default one-year expiry entirely. Only meaningful when
    DateTime? CreateApiKeyRequest.ExpiresAt is omitted — setting both is rejected rather than silently
    preferring one, since a client sending both almost certainly means only one of them.

members.description: Ids of the member tables to combine. Must be >= 2, all owned by the restaurant, none already grouped.

combinedSeats.description: Stored combined seating capacity; validated >= sum of member seats and <= int BookingLimits.MaxSeats.

minutes.description: Additional minutes to add to the booking's EndTime.

tableId.description:
Specific table to hold. When null (and int? PlaceHoldRequest.SectionId is also null), the
server auto-assigns the best available table across all sections ("Any section" flow).

sectionId.description:
Specific section of int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableId. When null (and int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableId is
also null), the server auto-assigns. Must be provided whenever int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableId is.

tableGroupId.description:
Combinable-table group to hold (#272). When set, the server resolves the group's members and
places a single hold reserving all of them. Mutually exclusive with int? PlaceHoldRequest.TableId.

seats.description:
Party size. Required for auto-assign and group holds (so the server can validate capacity);
ignored for explicit-table holds (the capacity check happens at booking time).

date.description: Full ISO 8601 datetime of the intended booking.

currentHoldId.description: If the caller already holds this ID, the backend atomically replaces it.

sectionIds.description:
The restaurant's sections, in the desired display order. Must contain exactly the
same set of section IDs the restaurant currently has (no additions/removals here).

openHours.description: Resolved hours for every day of the week (always 7 entries).

description.description: Optional blurb shown on the public location detail page (null when none).

menuUrl.description: Optional link to this location's menu (null when none).

phoneNumber.description: Optional contact phone for this location (null when none — callers fall back to the brand phone).

emailAddress.description: Optional contact email for this location (null when none — callers fall back to the brand email).

walkInOnly.description: When true the whole location is walk-in only — the booking flow is disabled.

walkInDays.description: Comma-separated ISO days (1=Monday … 7=Sunday) that are walk-in only ("" when none).

bookingSlotIntervalMinutes.description: Step (minutes) between selectable booking start times (default 30).

maxTableOversizeSeats.description: Max allowed spare seats over party size, or null for unrestricted (off).

bookingRefFormat.description: Format of references minted for new bookings: "AlphaNumeric" or "Numeric".

groups.description: Combinable-table groups defined for this restaurant (#271). Empty when none.

TableGroupDto.description:
A combinable-table group (#271): physical tables an admin flagged as combinable, bookable as one
unit for larger parties. `CombinedSeats` is the stored capacity; `Members` are the
physical tables pushed together.

description.description:
Optional freeform blurb shown on the public location detail page. Supports basic
markdown-style inline links. Empty string clears the field; null leaves it untouched.

menuUrl.description:
Optional link to this location's menu (PDF, page, etc.). Empty string clears the
field; null leaves it untouched.

phoneNumber.description:
Optional contact phone number for this location, overriding the global brand phone.
Empty string clears the field; null leaves it untouched.

emailAddress.description:
Optional contact email address for this location, overriding the global brand email.
Empty string clears the field; null leaves it untouched.

openHours.description:
Per-day opening hours (ISO day 1=Monday … 7=Sunday). When provided, takes
precedence over OpenTime/CloseTime; identical hours for all 7 days collapse
back into the uniform OpenTime/CloseTime pair.

bookingSlotIntervalMinutes.description:
Step, in minutes, between selectable booking start times. Null leaves the stored
value untouched (PATCH-style); validated server-side against the allowed set (15/30/60).

maxTableOversizeSeats.description:
Max allowed `table.Seats - partySize` before a table is considered too large to
offer/book. Null clears the setting (unrestricted). Always assigned from the settings
form so "Off" can be re-saved; validated server-side as non-negative.

bookingRefFormat.description:
Booking reference format for new bookings — "AlphaNumeric" (three words) or "Numeric"
(digits only), case-insensitive. Null leaves the stored value untouched (PATCH-style).
Sent as a string rather than the enum because the API has no string-enum converter
configured, and a bare int would be an opaque contract for the client.

walkInOnly.description: When true the whole location becomes walk-in only (no online bookings).

walkInDays.description: Comma-separated ISO days (1=Monday … 7=Sunday) that are walk-in only. Empty string clears.
